fields.acceptance: Go tests in the daemon app's package with a fake runner: the Confirm starts at the paused value daemon.settings gives, flipping it and submitting calls daemon.set with rhiza.daemon.paused and the new value and quits, submitting unchanged or Esc calls no daemon.set.
fields.statement: The Daemon app's rexuikit Form shows whether the daemon is paused as a Confirm, prefilled from daemon.settings; submitting a change writes rhiza.daemon.paused through daemon.set and closes the app.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in the daemon app's package with a fake runner: the field starts at maxRuns from daemon.settings, a positive integer is written with daemon.set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns and the app quits, a non-number or 0 is refused by the field's validator and calls nothing.
fields.statement: The same Form shows the run limit as a Text field prefilled from rhiza.daemon.maxRuns; submitting a valid new limit writes it through daemon.set and closes the app.
